plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for MikroTik switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, board/CPU temperature, fan speed, power-supply state, input voltage, and interface traffic, for RouterOS (enterprise PEN 14988).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device, read per processor core from HOST-RESOURCES-MIB hrProcessorLoad, normalized to a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the number of bytes currently in use by the MikroTik (RouterOS) system memory. hrStorageTable is walked by column, only the hrStorageRam row is kept, and hrStorageUsed is multiplied by hrStorageAllocationUnits to give bytes. It helps administrators understand absolute memory consumption and identify when the device is under memory pressure.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total size in bytes of the MikroTik (RouterOS) system memory: hrStorageSize of the hrStorageRam row multiplied by hrStorageAllocationUnits. Together with the used bytes it determines overall memory utilization.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device, computed as used / total * 100. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the board temperature of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device (MIKROTIK-MIB mtxrHlTemperature, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.3.10.0), in degrees Celsius. The device reports tenths of a degree (DISPLAY-HINT d-1), so the value is divided by 10 at collection. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_cpu_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: CPU temperature of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device (MIKROTIK-MIB mtxrHlProcessorTemperature, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.3.11.0) in degrees Celsius, divided by 10 from tenths of a degree at collection. Models without a CPU sensor do not report it.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Fan rotation speed in RPM of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device (MIKROTIK-MIB mtxrHlFanSpeed1/mtxrHlFanSpeed2, scalars 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.3.17.0 / .18.0). Fanless models do not report it. A drop to zero on a fan-cooled model indicates a stalled fan and a risk of overheating.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device (MIKROTIK-MIB mtxrHlPowerSupplyState / mtxrHlBackupPowerSupplyState, scalars 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.3.15.0 / .16.0). The BoolValue true(1) is normalized to 1 (normal) and false(0) to 2 (abnormal). Only dual-PSU models report it.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Input voltage of the MikroTik (RouterOS) device (MIKROTIK-MIB mtxrHlVoltage, scalar 1.3.6.1.4.1.14988.1.1.3.8.0) in volts, divided by 10 from tenths of a volt at collection. Values outside the adapter or PoE rated range may indicate unstable power.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
